          ROLE_APIKEY_OPERATION | ROLE_APIKEY_MAINTENANCE | ROLE_APIKEY_ADMIN

tools.name: netlicensing_create_bundle
tools.title: Create bundle
tools.description:
Create a new bundle grouping one or more license templates.

Args:
    number: Unique bundle number (e.g. 'B001')
    name: Human-readable bundle name
    license_template_numbers: List of license template numbers included in the bundle
    active: Whether the bundle is active
    price: Optional bundle price
    currency: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. EUR, USD — leave empty for account default)
    description: Optional bundle description
    include_raw: When true, include the sanitized NetLicensing API response under 'raw' (the upstream reply, before this tool's normalization)

outputSchema.description: Same JSON as the text content; a result that is not an object is {"result": value}.
outputSchema.title: NetLicensingToolResult

tools.name: netlicensing_create_license
tools.title: Create license
tools.description:
Assign a new license to a customer from a license template.

Args:
    licensee_number: Customer to assign the license to
    license_template_number: Template defining type and rules
    number: Optional custom license number (auto-generated if empty)
    active: Whether the license is active immediately
    name: Display name (defaults from template if empty)
    start_date: ISO 8601 datetime, or "now" for an immediate start; a time in the past is rejected — mandatory for TIMEVOLUME type
    price: License price (overrides template default, omit to inherit)
    currency: ISO 4217 currency code (overrides template default)
    time_volume: Duration value — mandatory for TIMEVOLUME type
    time_volume_period: DAY | WEEK | MONTH | YEAR (TIMEVOLUME type)
    quantity: Usage quota — mandatory for PayPerUse / NodeLocked models
    parent_feature: Parent feature — mandatory for TIMEVOLUME + Rental model
    hidden: Hide license from end customer in Shop (omit to inherit)
    include_raw: When true, include the sanitized NetLicensing API response under 'raw' (the upstream reply, before this tool's normalization)

outputSchema.description: Same JSON as the text content; a result that is not an object is {"result": value}.
outputSchema.title: NetLicensingToolResult

tools.name: netlicensing_create_license_template
tools.title: Create license template
tools.description:
Create a license template.

Args:
    module_number: Parent product module
    number: Unique template number (e.g. 'LT01')
    name: Template display name
    license_type: FEATURE | TIMEVOLUME | FLOATING | QUANTITY
    price: Template price (0 for free)
    currency: ISO 4217 currency code (default EUR)
    automatic: Auto-assign this license to new licensees
    hidden: Hide template in NetLicensing Shop
    hide_licenses: Hide licenses derived from this template in the Shop
    active: Whether the template is active
    time_volume: Number of time units (TIMEVOLUME type)
    time_volume_period: DAY | WEEK | MONTH | YEAR (TIMEVOLUME type)
    max_sessions: Concurrent sessions allowed (FLOATING type)
    quantity: Usage quota (QUANTITY / PayPerUse type)
    grace_period: Allow grace period after expiry (Subscription model)
    custom_properties: Additional properties as key-value pairs (e.g. skus for PricingTable, description)
    include_raw: When true, include the sanitized NetLicensing API response under 'raw' (the upstream reply, before this tool's normalization)

outputSchema.description: Same JSON as the text content; a result that is not an object is {"result": value}.
outputSchema.title: NetLicensingToolResult

tools.name: netlicensing_delete_bundle
tools.title: Delete bundle
tools.description:
Delete a bundle permanently.

Always requires a two-step confirmation:
1. Call without confirm_token (or call netlicensing_preview_delete_bundle)
   to receive a preview and a short-lived confirmation token.
2. Call again with the confirm_token within 5 minutes to execute.

Args:
    bundle_number: Bundle to delete
    force_cascade: Force deletion even if dependencies exist
    confirm_token: Confirmation token from a previous preview call

outputSchema.description: Same JSON as the text content; a result that is not an object is {"result": value}.
outputSchema.title: NetLicensingToolResult

tools.name: netlicensing_explain_validation
tools.title: Explain validation
tools.description:
Run a dry-run validation and return a plain-language explanation.

Wraps validate_licensee with dryRun=true and translates the result into
per-module status, explanations, and suggested_actions (renewal tokens,
top-up flows, force-checkin advice). This tool is READ-ONLY — it never
consumes floating sessions, quota, or node-lock slots.

Note: module_parameters currently passes the first entry's fields only
(single-module shorthand). Full multi-module indexed support is planned
for a future release (P0.5).

Args:
    licensee_number:   Licensee identifier (e.g. 'CUST-ACME').
    product_number:    Optional — scope validation to a single product.
    module_parameters: Optional per-module overrides. Each dict may
                       contain: product_module_number, node_secret,
                       session_id, action.
    include_raw:       When True, include the sanitized upstream
                       validate_licensee API response under 'raw'.

outputSchema.description: Same JSON as the text content; a result that is not an object is {"result": value}.
outputSchema.title: NetLicensingToolResult

Dependent licenses cannot be efficiently counted without enumerating all
licensees, so the preview always warns that licenses may be affected.
Returns a confirmation token.

Args:
    template_number: Template to preview deletion for

outputSchema.description: Same JSON as the text content; a result that is not an object is {"result": value}.
outputSchema.title: NetLicensingToolResult

tools.name: netlicensing_preview_delete_licensee
tools.title: Preview deletion of licensee
tools.description:
Preview what would be deleted when deleting a licensee.

Returns the count of licenses that would be removed, `requires_force_cascade` and
`blocking_dependencies` (a licensee with licenses cannot be deleted without
force_cascade), and a confirmation token.

Args:
    licensee_number: Licensee to preview deletion for

outputSchema.description: Same JSON as the text content; a result that is not an object is {"result": value}.
outputSchema.title: NetLicensingToolResult

tools.name: netlicensing_preview_delete_product
tools.title: Preview deletion of product
tools.description:
Preview what would be deleted when deleting a product.

Returns affected counts, sample entity identifiers, `requires_force_cascade`
and `blocking_dependencies` (a product with modules or licensees cannot be
deleted without force_cascade), and a short-lived confirmation token. The
token is bound to the force_cascade value used here: pass the same value,
with the token, to netlicensing_delete_product within 5 minutes.

Args:
    product_number: Product to preview deletion for
    force_cascade: Preview a cascade delete (also removes dependent modules, templates, licensees and licenses)

outputSchema.description: Same JSON as the text content; a result that is not an object is {"result": value}.
outputSchema.title: NetLicensingToolResult

tools.name: netlicensing_preview_delete_product_module

without force_cascade), and a confirmation token.

Args:

outputSchema.description: Same JSON as the text content; a result that is not an object is {"result": value}.

tools.name: netlicensing_server_info
tools.title: Get server info
tools.description:
Check this MCP server's setup and its NetLicensing connection.

Call this FIRST on a new setup, and whenever another tool fails with an
authentication, connection or configuration error: 'status' ("ok",
"warning" or "error") and 'next_steps' (plain-language sentences to pass
on to the user) say what to fix.

Returns version, NetLicensing API host (base_url), demo_mode, transport
(stdio or http), toolsets, read_only and tool_count, plus 'auth'
({configured, source: env|header|demo|none, valid: true|false|null}),
'checks' ([{name, ok, detail}]) and 'warnings'. Never returns the API key.

Args:
    check_connection: When true (default), make one cheap read-only API call (list one product, short timeout) to check that the API is reachable and accepts the credentials; when false, make no API call (auth.valid stays null)

outputSchema.description: Same JSON as the text content; a result that is not an object is {"result": value}.
outputSchema.title: NetLicensingToolResult

tools.name: netlicensing_transfer_licenses
tools.title: Transfer licenses
tools.description:
Transfer all licenses from one licensee to another.

The source licensee must be marked for transfer (markedForTransfer=true)
and both licensees must be active. The source licensee is consumed.

Args:
    from_licensee_number: Source licensee
    to_licensee_number: Destination licensee
    include_raw: Accepted for consistency; the API returns no body (204)

outputSchema.description: Same JSON as the text content; a result that is not an object is {"result": value}.
outputSchema.title: NetLicensingToolResult

tools.name: netlicensing_validate_licensee
tools.title: Validate licensee
tools.description:
Validate a customer's licenses across all product modules.

Returns the list envelope with one ProductModuleValidation item per module
(validity, type, expiry, usage; Floating expirationTimestamp and session data
are kept), even when only one module is validated. API infos (ERROR, WARNING,
INFO — e.g. "No free floating licenses found.") appear in 'warnings'.

Module-scoped parameters (session_id, action, node_secret) require
product_module_number, and one call addresses ONE module. A call that is not
a dry run still validates every module of the product, so other Floating or
NodeLocked modules may report their own missing-parameter errors.

Args:
    licensee_number: Customer to validate
    product_number: Optional — scope validation to a specific product
    licensee_name: Human-readable name for auto-created licensees (when licenseeAutoCreate is enabled)
    session_id: Floating model — unique session identifier (needs product_module_number;
        required with action)
    action: Floating model — 'checkOut' or 'checkIn' (needs product_module_number and session_id)
    product_module_number: Module that session_id / action / node_secret apply to;
        required when any of them is given
    node_secret: NodeLocked model — unique device/node secret (needs product_module_number)
    dry_run: When true, validate without side effects: never checks out, checks in,
        binds a node or consumes anything. Default false.
    include_raw: When true, include the sanitized NetLicensing API response under 'raw' (the upstream reply, before this tool's normalization)

outputSchema.description: Same JSON as the text content; a result that is not an object is {"result": value}.
outputSchema.title: NetLicensingToolResult
